_staged: NOT ENABLED. This file is inert here — Cursor only loads .cursor/mcp.json. It becomes live only after Marcus's security review, by copying it to .cursor/mcp.json with a real token supplied at enable time. See .cursor/staged/README.md.

_design.job: Pull issue, PR, review, and CI evidence into /scope-issue, /first-contribution, and /renewal-evidence without manual transcription.
_design.privilege: Read-only by design: GITHUB_READ_ONLY=1 plus a fine-grained personal access token scoped to this repository with read-only permissions. No write path to issues, PRs, or code.
_design.token_handling: The token is never committed. It is injected from the environment at enable time by the person who owns the credential.
_design.toolsets: Restricted to issues, pull_requests, and actions — the three surfaces the evidence ledger reads. Everything else stays off until a workflow earns it.
_design.review_gate: Marcus (DevOps/platform) approves scopes, token custody, and egress before this leaves staged/.

env.GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN: <injected at enable time: fine-grained PAT, read-only, this repository only>
